property_summary: For all callers, the deployed (reference) contract only allows setL1BlockValues to succeed when msg.sender equals the runtime-stored depositorAccount; the mutant erroneously allows the hard-coded DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT to call successfully, so there exist callers (fuzzed) for which reference rejects but mutant accepts.
change_summary: Change the require to check msg.sender == DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT (constant) instead of depositorAccount, allowing the call when sent by the hardcoded constant address.
